peers.name: hyperframes-cli
peers.description: HyperFrames CLI - scaffold, check frames, edit timelines, preview, render, share and project history; read JSON and recover from failures.

peers.name: hyperframes
peers.description: Read first to make, edit, animate or render any video with HyperFrames (HTML rendered to video), including launch films, explainers, music videos, charts, maps, vertical clips, title cards, captions and overlays. Holds the render contract, the work loop and what each kind of video needs.

peers.name: hyperframes-registry
peers.description: About 450 ready-made HyperFrames blocks and components installed as editable source - transitions, overlays, titles, kinetic type, captions, charts, map overlays, 3D, camera moves. Use it before hand-building any named visual (CRT scanlines, glitch, film grain, a chart); also for hyperframes add and catalog.

en.tagline: Get, make and grade media for HyperFrames videos
en.summary: media-use finds or generates the media a HyperFrames video needs: music, sound effects, images, icons, logos, voiceover, avatar video, transcripts, cutouts and colour grades. It uses HeyGen or free local tools. It also treats footage that looks dark, flat or dull.
problem: A HyperFrames video often needs media that the project does not have yet. Without this skill, you search for each asset, download it, check its licence and place it in the project by hand.
With media-use, one command resolves each need into a local file in the project's assets/ folder, with a ledger record. Renders do not fetch media from the network.
fit: Adding music, sound effects or a voiceover to a HyperFrames video
Replacing placeholder images, emoji or missing logos with real assets
Grading, stylising or hiding parts of footage that looks dark, flat or dull
unfit: Projects that do not use HyperFrames
Videos that need no new media and no footage treatment
steps: When a request needs a HeyGen model or the catalog, run `npx hyperframes auth status` first and ask the person to sign in if needed.
List reusable assets with `--candidates` and judge whether they fit.
Run `npx hyperframes media-use resolve --type <type> --intent "<what you need>" --project <dir>` for each missing asset.
The asset is saved in the project's assets/ folder with a ledger record, and the command prints its id and path.
For footage that needs a look, inspect the real video or image and apply a treatment with `npx hyperframes media-treatment`.
Mix the placed audio with fades, gain and ducking as described in the mixing reference.

zh.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 视频获取、生成和调色媒体素材
zh.summary: media-use 为 HyperFrames 视频查找或生成所需的媒体，包括音乐、音效、图片、图标、logo、配音、数字人视频、字幕转写、抠图和调色。它可以使用 HeyGen，也可以使用免费的本地工具。对于偏暗、发灰或平淡的素材，它也能处理。
problem: HyperFrames 视频经常需要项目里还没有的媒体。没有这个技能时，你需要逐个搜索素材、下载、核对授权，再手动放进项目。
使用 media-use 后，一条命令就能把每个需求解析成项目 assets/ 目录下的本地文件，并生成台账记录。渲染时不会从网络拉取素材。
fit: 为 HyperFrames 视频添加音乐、音效或配音
用真实素材替换占位图片、表情符号或缺失的 logo
对偏暗、发灰或平淡的素材做调色、风格化处理，或遮挡其中部分画面
unfit: 不使用 HyperFrames 的项目
不需要新增媒体，也不需要处理素材画面的视频
steps: 当请求需要 HeyGen 模型或素材库时，先运行 `npx hyperframes auth status`，如未登录，请用户登录。
用 `--candidates` 列出可复用的素材，并判断是否合适。
对每个缺失的素材运行 `npx hyperframes media-use resolve --type <type> --intent "<需要的内容>" --project <dir>`。
素材会保存到项目的 assets/ 目录并生成台账记录，命令会输出其 id 和路径。
对需要调整画面效果的素材，先查看真实的视频或图片，再用 `npx hyperframes media-treatment` 应用处理。
按混音参考文档，对已放入的音频做淡入淡出、增益和压低伴奏处理。
